'''Santhe Corporation''', also '''Santhe Industries''', was the overseeing holding company of the various Santhe and Sienar corporations. The two main subsidiaries of Santhe Corporation were [[Santhe Security]] and [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]]. Through the latter company, Santhe Corporation also controlled [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], [[Santhe Passenger and Freight]], and [[Curich Engineering]].

Less than a century before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Liann]] industrialist [[Kerred Santhe]] acquired a controlling share of [[Sienar Technologies]] and its subsidiary [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]]. [[Narro Sienar]] took over as [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] from [[Kerred Santhe the Second|Santhe's son]], until his death in [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]]. His son, [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]], took over as CEO of Santhe/Sienar Technologies and Sienar Fleet Systems. When Raith was assassinated, Kerred's granddaughter and head of the [[Santhe family/Legends|Santhe family]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valles Santhe]] took direct control of Santhe/Sienar Technologies and its subsidiaries, and maintained it throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and into the [[New Republic era]].
